text:
maria-fin: Received invoice from Sentinel Supply — invoice #SS-78923 for $9,750. No PO attached on their PDF, vendor claims PO 45782 but our AP system shows PO 45783. Need approver routing and GL code confirmation for Feb 28 pay run. Attaching PDF :paperclip:

luke-procure: pinging @ana-cfo for delegation if procurement needs to remap. procurement system shows PO 45782 is CLOSED. @nina-accounting any quick match? :eyes:

nina-accounting: I pulled the scan — vendor typed 45782 on the invoice header but OCR didn't match. AP matcher returns no match. If vendor insists 45782 we need original PO pdf or a PO change request. Can we hold until EOD? Payment run at 18:00 PT.

sentinel-bot: Sentinel Supply (vendor-contact) uploaded invoice PDF: SS-78923 and packing_list_SS-78923.pdf. Vendor attached a change note referencing Sales Order SO-9001. Link: https://files.redwood/sentinel/SS-78923.pdf

vendor-contact: Sorry about the confusion — we referenced our sales order not the PO. Can you confirm the correct PO number so we can reissue? Contact: lisa@sentinel.com

maria-fin: We need to either remap to PO 45783 or get a vendor reissue. Note: vendor put GL 6025 (Consulting) but procurement thinks this should hit GL 6010 (Hardware). Procurement — ok to approve remap if goods match?

luke-procure: Procurement can approve remap to 45783 only after ops confirms goods received against 45783. I'll check with ops and report back by 15:00 PT.

ana-typo (system): (edited)

ana-typo should not appear — ignore this line.

ana-cfo: If procurement signs off, I can approve a one-time delegation for payment. @nina-accounting please add tag `invoice_exception` with reason for audit trail. Also cc legal since amount > $5k.

nina-accounting: Added tag and opened manual match ticket AP-3045. Holding payment pending vendor reissue or procurement confirmation. @maria-fin paste vendor email thread here.

maria-fin: lisa@sentinel.com (vendor contact). @luke-procure please confirm by 15:30 PT so I can decide for the 18:00 pay run.

vendor-contact: Confirmed — goods on SO-9001 match PO 45783. We'll reissue invoice with PO 45783 and GL 6010 by noon. Apologies for the mix-up.

nina-accounting: Great — once we get the reissued invoice we can auto-match and release hold. For audit note: "vendor reissued invoice SS-78923 with correct PO 45783 and GL 6010; manual hold released by Nina".

ana-cfo: :thumbsup: I will approve delegation after procurement confirms in thread.

maria-fin: Thanks everyone — I'll watch for the reissued PDF and close out after payment.

nina-accounting: Manual hold released after reissue; payment scheduled in the 18:00 PT run. Closing thread.
